title: ‘Gut-wrenching pain’: First conviction in French school sex abuse scandal fails to quell parents’ anger
summary: A Paris court on Tuesday sentenced a former school aide to one year of house arrest with an ankle tag for sexually abusing nine children – the first conviction since a nationwide scandal erupted over abuse in France's childcare system.
